author: SnowSX3
body:
Piinqed was recently warned for spam.
I believe atdit recently sent an online report about him?

Piinqed got an offline warn but if you look at his infraction history, a temp ban or perma ban needs to be issued.

https://avicus.net/piinqed#punishments

Im not sure what the excessive infraction policy is anymore but some sort of ban needs to be put in place.

Why was he warned in the first place? It was an offline report so the Mod had to look at the player's history before punishing.

Did they not see the dozens of infractions?

Fix please. 
Thanks.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heey Snow,

I understand your concern that that really shouldn'h have happened, but rather be lenient than to harsh.
Also I think strucken already mentioned it in slack that he reminded the moderators to use /history.

Maybe we need to define a time how long a warn lasts for, like if a player is warned and if he breaks the same rule within 2 weeks again, he's eligible for a kick, if it's out of this time period, he will be warned again. (Just an example). Your opinion on it?

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I don't think it needs to be that specific.
As you can see, within the last 4 weeks, this user has had 5 chat related warns.

For such a small time period, and taking into consideration that they're all chat related offenders, you'd expect the punishment to increase.

With this specific instance, it's not a case of being lenient lenient or harsh, these punishments should increase in severity.

Clearly, this player isn't getting the message. So why continue to warn him when it falls on deaf ears?

What does the punishment guideline say about repeat offenses?
One would assume it recommends a gradual increase in severity for similar offenses?

replies.body:
Heeya Snow,

as Jahaj said the rule/policy changed again or actually wasn't changed in the first place.
Due to this his excessive infractions ban was removed.

But I still believe he still has to face a punishment for his recent chat behavior so I decided to temporary ban him for a week, so he can reflect on his actions.

I hope this is the last time I can say this report is accepted.

Regards Flo/resepignev
